description: Free — this call never consumes credits or quota. — and it will never be charged, by design. Use this whenever something about this API got in your way: an error you could not act on, a parameter that did not behave as documented, a capability you needed and could not find, or a result that was wrong. Include the requestId from a failed call and the team sees exactly what happened on their side. A human reads these. Do not include API keys or other secrets.
